[Retryability](/ɹitɹˌaɪəbˈɪlɪti/) differs from [retryable](/ɹitɹˈaɪəbəl/), and [retriability](/ɹitɹˌaɪəbˈɪlɪti/) is a variant spelling.
An [Invalid](/ɪnvˈælɪd/) [JSON](/ʤˈeɪsˌɑn/) body is not the same as plain [JSON](/ʤˈeɪsˌɑn/).
